newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends at 35.88/89, RBI buys spot dlrs.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends at 35.88/89, RBI buys spot dlrs.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed at 35.8850/8900 against the dollar on Friday marginally down from the opening 35.8750/8850, dealers said.
"There wasn't much movement today," said a dealer.
He said Friday's trading range was 35.8750-35.8875.
Dealers said there was mild corporate demand for dollars in the morning session which was easily met by good supplies.
They said the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) was in the market buying spot dollars first at 35.8850. It later raised its dollar price upto 35.8875 rupees per dollar, dealers said.
The six month annualised premium closed at 7.02 percent, up from the Thursday's of 6.97 percent, dealers said.
Some dealers said they did not expect RBI to continue its outright dollar purchases in the forward market.
One dealer said he expected RBI to go slow on its forward purchases after March 31, the last day of fiscal year 1996/97.
